capture_method: Every tracked record is a real upstream capture from www.sec.gov, data.sec.gov and efts.sec.gov fetched over plain HTTPS with a declared research User-Agent ('WebHarbor Mirror Research admin@webharbor.example') under the SEC fair-access policy (<= 2 req/s, well under the 10 req/s ceiling). 168 primary captures plus per-page captures for press releases, litigation release detail pages, administrative proceeding detail pages, FAST Answers and images; every capture carries a .meta.json sidecar with the exact URL, HTTP status, byte length and UTC timestamp. Zero synthesized records among the captured blocks; the two declared fixture blocks below are the only authored content.
waf_note: investor.gov (which hosts the live Investor Alerts & Bulletins catalog and the FAST Answers glossary beyond the five pages still served by sec.gov) and help.sec.gov (the Salesforce-hosted form shell) block automated fetches from this network: investor.gov returns Akamai 403 on every path including its RSS feed; help.sec.gov serves only a JavaScript shell behind a certificate chain this environment cannot verify. Following the u_s_customs precedent, the mirror models those sections with deterministic authored fixtures (origin='fixture' in the DB, visibly tagged on the pages) and declares them here. Everything else is live upstream capture: www.sec.gov, data.sec.gov and efts.sec.gov all returned HTTP 200 for every request with no anti-bot challenge.

determinism.seed: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 seed_data.py at image build time (also verified identical under PYTHONHASHSEED=42/7/12345: the seeder has no hash-order dependence)
determinism.index_note: each table declares at most one secondary index so db.create_all() emits schema DDL in a fixed order (multi-index tables iterate a set and break byte-identity)

determinism.tarball_seed_note: the pinned asset tarball ships a convenience copy of the local caliber as instance_seed/sec.db; the Docker build deletes instance_seed/ and regenerates it deterministically, so that copy is build-time dead weight — annotated via sites/sec/.build-generated-seed
